scope: Retained Stack-Edu v1+v2 finite stock only; not an upstream-release or expansion-yield estimate. No new network acquisition, corpus execution or training.
strata: Census language x existing path role (vendor/test/docs_example/other) x tokens <=4096 or >4096; preserve census role semantics. Other is not a practical-code label.
sampling: Within each nonempty stratum take min(2,N) lowest SHA256(seed:record_id), tie-break by record_id. All finite-stock records remain in the frame; do not exclude holds, prior reviews or failures, and never replace a failed selection. Freeze before source inspection.
measurements: Population files/tokens and selected files/tokens per stratum; retain n/N inclusion probabilities and N/n expansion weights.
Verify archive/member/source identities, source metadata and exact token counts; recover complete selected text outside Git.
Apply the existing 22-lane exclusion screen, then propagate known/new holds through named repositories and supplied aliases. Record missing full-family/near-duplicate coverage.
Report preflight outcomes separately from natural-code eligibility and independently verified-exercise eligibility. No-hit is not approval.

review_protocol.natural_code: Require exact source/origin and notice evidence, source-use review, exclusions/near-deduplication and useful intact content. Complete independent executable tests are not a blanket natural-code requirement.
review_protocol.verified_exercise: Additionally require a clear task specification, same-revision implementation/test linkage, bound dependencies, non-vacuous tests, independent oracles and deliberately wrong controls in isolation.
review_protocol.first_pass: Offline recovery/content screening only. Origin, source-use, semantic quality, security and behavioral gates remain unassessed unless a separately bound review supplies evidence.
review_protocol.failure_policy: Hash mismatch invalidates the run. Unavailable sources and failed eligibility checks remain in their original selected strata and denominators.
review_protocol.estimation: Unweighted sample proportions are not corpus yield. Any later document-yield estimate must use stratum expansion weights; token estimates must expand token-weighted outcomes, not multiply a file pass rate by all tokens. Account for repository clustering and tiny cells in uncertainty. Do not publish an eligible-yield estimate from incomplete gate assessment.
